mapper.select: SELECT es.*, e.name AS exam_name, s.student_name AS student_name, s.student_code AS student_number, c.class_name AS class_name FROM exam_score es LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = es.exam_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = es.student_id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = es.class_id WHERE es.exam_id = #{examId} AND es.student_id = #{studentId}
